prompts.text: Explain, in three careful paragraphs, why the sky appears blue during the day and red at sunset.
Write a short essay on the history of the printing press and its effect on literacy in Europe.
Summarize the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis for a general reader.

Write a long-form magazine feature, at least two thousand words, about how a small coastal town adapted its fishing economy to a changing climate over thirty years. Use named (fictional) residents, concrete dates and numbers, and end with what the next decade may hold.
